# PLAN — Chapter 0 · 学棋 → 照见 → 觉悟人生

**Updated:** 2026-11-11 · **Domain:** arts-design · Generated by harness-factory 0.1.0, then concretized by the agent (see `.harness/PROVENANCE.md`).

> **Round 2 (2026-11-12) supersedes the counts below.** The current state is 11 steps + a guided 21-move
> game, 63 tests; the evaluation, findings and next tasks are in the last section.
> Round 1 remains the record of what was planned and verified on 2026-11-11.

> Plan first. One verifiable increment at a time; results go to `PROGRESS.md`.
> Nothing in this file is a claim of completed work. Every state starts **false**.

## Goal

Add a **Chapter 0** to One Breath MVP: one concrete life case carries an interactive lesson in how Go actually works; the same position is then read as that case; the experience closes in a bounded 觉悟人生 stage that still ends in a concrete response.

One sentence: **the player learns 气 / 提子 / 双活 / 虚着 by playing the position their own situation is made of, then sees the two readings are one shape, then sits with it — and still has to act.**

## Confirmed reading (requirement refinement R0–R5)

- **Reading:** **Elevated — interactive**. Confirmed by the user on 2026-11-11 (all four recommended options).
- **D1 · Case vehicle:** new case **同气 / The Shared Corridor**. The Two Sides stays an independent transfer proof — reusing it here would weaken the research claim in `docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:16-17`.
- **D2 · 觉悟人生:** the **third stage**, mapped onto Release → Respond. 坐观 (four dharmadhatu views) is its instrument. No fifth movement replaces Respond (`docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:15`).
- **D3 · Scope:** interactive ladder, computed shared liberty, 照见 by clicking, 觉 → 行. 3–4 sessions.
- **D4 · Placement:** **Chapter 0** on the title screen, before the two existing cases. After 行, the player enters them.

### Constraint classification

**Hard** (do not trade away):

- Four movements, Respond mandatory — `docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:15`.
- No score / no moral ranking / no AI / no telemetry — `docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:17,127-128`.
- Legal Go rules; rules are not bent to force a moral — `docs/_extract_mvp.md:67,108`.
- Bilingual completeness by meaning unit (M4.10) — `docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:73-90`.
- Deterministic single-file build with recorded sha256 — `docs/MVP-BUILD-PLAN.md:22,140`.
- 6–10 minutes total — `docs/_extract_mvp.md:13`.
- §11 language boundary: never claim the experience produces enlightenment — `docs/_extract_mvp.md:208-220`.

**Soft** (trade with a stated reason):

- Wordless-first chrome (`app/main.js:1-7`); the teaching act is the one place captions are always on.
- 5×5 boards; ink palette; warm palette only for case two.
- 坐观 remains skippable at every step.

**Assumed → now resolved / still open:**

- Resolved by D1–D4 above.
- **Open:** whether a *legible* two-eye shape fits on 5×5. If it does not, the teaching board alone goes 7×7 — that touches the "one board size" constraint and needs your nod. Prove geometry before deciding (S0).

## Steps

### S0 · Design lock (no UI)

Write the geometry and the lesson data first; prove every asserted property in both engines before a pixel moves.

- `specs/board-shared-breath.yaml`: setup, beats, `roles`, `same_as`, assertions.
- `specs/lessons.yaml`: 7 steps (4 core, 3 optional), bilingual rule line per step, task spec per step.
- Extend `tools/verify.py` with the same beat reader and the exhaustive no-killing-move check.
- New `tests/teaching.test.js`: write the red cases first, then make them green.
- **Deliverable:** geometry report + green G4–G11 on data/rules only.
- **Exit:** two implementations agree; two-eye legibility measured; board-size decision brought to you if it fails.

### S1 · Teaching runtime (4 core beats)

- `app/rules.js`: `eyes()`, `allLegalMoves()`, `hasKillingMove()` as pure functions.
- `app/board-mirror.js`: hit-testing, role labels, ghost outlines, capture animation, reduced-motion still path.
- `app/teaching.js`: step runtime — show → try → confirm/refuse; no score.
- `app/main.js`: Chapter 0 entry + lesson screen; keep the existing scene machine intact.
- **Deliverable:** 气 → 提子 → 双活 → 虚着 playable; optional 连接 / 禁入点 / 两眼 reachable.
- **Exit:** G4–G7, G12; manual pass in the browser at 3 viewport widths.

### S2 · 照见 → 觉悟人生 → 行

- Two-pane 照见: case text left, board right; one click resolves the same id in both.
- "Which chain is you?" — declared mapping, no right answer, no score.
- Wire the existing `dharmadhatu.js` to the lesson's own initial/final positions (the ghosts are the stones the player lifted).
- Fifth screen 回到走廊: five unranked responses, each stating what it protects.
- **Exit:** G8–G11; reduced-motion screenshots; skippable at every step.

### S3 · Gates, build, bilingual

- Full suite, build twice, sha recorded.
- Glossary entries: 眼, 双活, 禁入点, 自杀, 活棋, 同气, 照见, 觉悟人生.
- Back-translation of the English side; native-reader pass on the Chinese; record in `docs/corroboration-record.md`.
- **Exit:** G1–G3, G13–G15.

### S4 · Mentor check (human)

Three first-time players, then a mentor walkthrough. S1–S3 are soft gates: report what was observed, not what was hoped. No efficacy claim.

## Bilingual plan

1. Every lesson rule line is authored as a `{zh, en}` meaning-unit pair, written together — not translated after the fact.
2. Glossary first; culture-bound terms carried verbatim + glossed; 气 / liberty vs breath kept distinct.
3. English side back-translated unit by unit; Chinese side read by a native reader for "what did you understand".
4. Machine gate: every key present in both languages, non-empty, placeholders identical.
5. Record appended to `docs/corroboration-record.md`; no claim of translation quality beyond the recorded checks.

## Risks and open items

- **Two eyes on 5×5 — resolved by measurement.** The 5×5 corner group has exactly two eyes,
  `(2,2)` and `(3,3)`, and no legal white move inside either; both engines agree.
- **Time budget — Round 2 open.** The ladder is now 11 steps plus a 21-move game; the optional
  (`core:false`) steps are linear and not individually skippable, so the 6–10 minute soft gate (S3) is at
  risk. Fix in PLAN Round 2 B; not yet timed with a first-time player.
- **Label risk** — "觉悟人生" must sit beside the §11 boundary caption, never as a claim of attainment.
- **Transfer proof** — do not reuse The Two Sides as the lesson; it is the non-Go proof.
- **New interaction surface** — free clicks widen the surface beyond scripted beats; determinism is pinned
  by click scripts and position hashes, and the browser smoke covers the full chapter.
- **Dense board** — the corridor position uses 21 stones on 5×5; the two chains are clear in the browser
  smoke, but first-time legibility is a soft gate (S1), not a machine gate.
- **Style** — the UI is now a restrained classical Chinese surface (rice paper, vermilion seal, hairline
  rules, single board frame); the panel pictograms remain the original ink language. A human look is still
  the final judge.

## First move — done, and it changed the design

The planned `shared_liberties == 1` did not survive measurement: a search over 5×5 positions found no
two-chain / two-liberty-each / one-shared-liberty shape within the tested space. The implemented position
is the four-point corridor (`libs(you) == libs(them) == corridor`), and its computed invariant is
**every first move loses the mover's chain** — 8 enumerated branches, re-derived independently in Python.
Evidence: `tests/teaching.test.js` and `tools/verify.py`; recorded in `.harness/decisions.md` #8.

## Findings, severity order

### P0 · the gates that cannot fail

1. **`tests/zugzwang.test.js` overclaims.** Its title says "EVERY first-attack × EVERY reply — the first
   mover always loses", but the third-attack loop (`:70–:81`) has empty `if/else` bodies, the only
   `firstMoverWins` increment tests a state that never occurs after the first exchange, and the test
   **never asserts a capture**. Line `:117` is a tautology
   (`assert.equal(you.liberties.size, you.liberties.size, "identity")`), and `:148` breaks after one
   reply, so it is not exhaustive. The real proof is `firstMoverLoses` in `app/teaching.js`, used by
   `tests/teaching.test.js:160` (8 branches). Fix: either make this file call `firstMoverLoses` and assert
   the 8 branches, or replace it with an actual minimax; remove the tautology; rename the third test to
   its real claim. Red example: add a fifth corridor point, or let the first mover survive one branch —
   the test must go red.

2. **`tests/differential-fuzz.test.js` overclaims.** The title says "agrees … on every step", but `:81–:84`
   accepts **≥95% agreement**, `:68–:80` logs hash mismatches and "real divergences" without failing, and
   the hash mismatch path is declared "informational". A differential gate that passes on a known
   divergence is not a correctness gate. Fix: require 100% agreement on `ok`, `reason`, `captured` and a
   canonical position hash; if a known divergence is unavoidable, mark it `xfail` with a tracked issue and
   a failing red test, not silence. Red example: inject a deliberate one-step divergence — the suite must
   fail.

3. **The no-score gate does not cover the guided game.** `specs/game-record.yaml:89,97` contains
   `score` and "决定胜负"; `lessons.yaml:209` says "不数输赢,数地"; `tests/vignette.test.js:92` is titled
   "no score … anywhere in the engine or specs" but only scans engine `score:` tokens and the Harmony
   Index in content. The game's `GameState.score()` is therefore outside the gate. The product shows a
   Go area count (12-4) — legitimate Go, but the *claim* and the *gate* now disagree. This is the one
   design decision that needs your word before code changes.

### P0 · narrative, time, stale docs

4. **The lesson count/time was stale.** The vignette now says "十手" (10 rule moves), while the ladder is
   10 rule steps + the 21-move game (11 in the counter); the card said about 6 minutes; the optional steps
   were linear. **Fixed:** the optional steps are individually skippable, the 11 dots became a compact
   progress rule, and the card says core 8–10 min. S3 still needs a first-time timing.

5. **Planning docs are stale.** `tasks/PLAN.md:86` and `AGENTS.md:119` say 7 steps; `PROGRESS.md` says
   40/40; `lessons.yaml:4` says core = 4; `.harness/decisions.md:17` fuses rows #11 and #12 into one
   table line. Update all four to the 11-step + game state.

### P1 · product and architecture

6. **`rules.js` now contradicts its own header.** Header: "this is NOT a Go engine"; the file now holds
   `GameState`, `score()`, and `teachingReply` (`:166–:304`). Move the game wrapper to `app/game.js` or
   amend the header; either is honest, the current state is not.
7. **`teachingReply` is unused in the product.** It is exercised only by `tests/game.test.js`; the game's
   white replies are authored. Either use it for a post-record free-play mode, or move it to a test
   helper so the shipped bundle does not carry a latent opponent.
8. **Bridge the game to the corridor.** The game ends at 12-4, then the next node asks the player to
   compare the corridor. Add one bridge line ("回到那条走廊") at the game's close or the compare's open;
   do not change the `same_as` invariant.

### P2 · visual and human evidence

9. The vision review (screenshots) confirms the classical surface, but flags: 11 step dots clutter;
   stones look like digital marbles rather than brush-worked stones; the hint/corridor marks are low
   contrast; the "Start here" seal reads slightly like a digital badge; the solid red primary button is
   heavy. Fix after the truth/time items.
10. **S1–S3 remain false**, and the native-reader pass on the Chinese is still yours
    (`docs/corroboration-record.md` §5.2). No machine gate can substitute for a first-time player.

## Proposed order

1. **P0-1 / P0-2** — make the two gates able to fail; run every new red example; then 63+ green.
2. **P0-3** — decide the score boundary; fix the wording and encode the boundary in the gate.
3. **P0-4 / P0-5** — fix the lesson count/time text; add the per-step skip or core/deep path; update PLAN,
   AGENTS, gates, PROGRESS, decisions.
4. **P1-6/7/8** — layering, dead code, bridge.
5. **S4** — three first-time players + mentor walkthrough + native-reader pass; record the observations.
6. **P2-9** — visual polish guided by the screenshots.

      game's area count is labelled 地 and is not a player rating.

      `tasks/PROGRESS.md` all describe 11 steps + the game, truthfully.

      (The skip exists; the timing is still pending.)

## Open decisions for you

- **A · Score boundary.** (i) Allow the Go area count only as 地/land in the guided game; forbid any
  score/rank on the five responses and endings; fix "决定胜负" (recommended). (ii) Remove the numeric
  count and keep only "both rested — the land is what remains". (iii) Keep the count and rewrite the
  no-score rule to say Go results are allowed.
- **B · Time path.** (i) Make `core:false` steps individually skippable and offer a core/deep path
  (recommended). (ii) Split the 21-move game into a separate "对弈" act after Chapter 0. (iii) Accept
  12–15 minutes and update the promise.
- **C · Fuzz gate.** (i) Enforce 100% agreement + canonical hash (recommended). (ii) Keep 95% but file a
  tracked issue and rename the test. (iii) Drop the hash check.
- **D · Visual priority.** (i) Brush-textured stones + a compact progress bar (recommended). (ii) Keep
  the clean gradient and the 11 dots. (iii) Only fix the hint contrast.
**Confirmed 2026-11-12:** A(i) land only, B(i) per-step skip + core path, C(i) 100% fuzz, D(i) brush
stones + compact progress + hint contrast.

### Simulated-persona walkthrough (2026-11-12)

`tools/human_sim.py` drove **six scripted personas** through the real UI: core zh (with deliberate
wrong clicks at 气 and 提子, and an off-script click at the game), core en, the full 11-step ladder,
the mentor who skips the teaching act, a 390×844 mobile player, and a reduced-motion player.
**0 page errors; 5 seals; land count; hint ring; corridor 2 → 4; 0 overflow** in every persona.

- **Found and fixed:** the mobile lesson overflowed (`scrollWidth 444` vs `innerWidth 390`;
  offenders `lesson-stage`, `lesson-board`, `lesson-side`). The 860/520 CSS now gives **390/390,
  0 offenders**; top navigation targets 30 → 44 px; the ending seal strip is 56 px; prompt,
  caption and footer contrast raised.
- **Open (P1):** keyboard accessibility — `#lesson-board` and `#compare-board` are `<canvas>` with
  `tabIndex -1` and no `tabindex`, so a keyboard-only player cannot complete Chapter 0. Needs an
  arrow-key grid / point-list fallback; not a CSS patch.
- **Timing model (heuristic, not a stopwatch):** core ~5.9–6.8 min zh / 4.8–5.4 en; full ~7.7–8.9 /
  6.4–7.3; mentor ~2.6–3.1 / 2.0–2.3. The card's 8–10 min is conservative for the core path.
- **Not proven:** S1 comprehension, S2 non-moralization, S3 real duration, the native-reader pass.
- **Artifacts:** `outputs/human-sim/REPORT.md`, `results.json`, per-persona screenshots; artifact sha
  `d70481136e8bf164a63c8f28f24043aeb681eab802ba703003350e291ba3dd3d`.
